NamedRef.description: NamedRef stores the name attribute used by CE reference elements such as usage, category, tag, value, type, and group.

name.description: Name is the identifier referenced by the containing CE element.

TypeDef.description: TypeDef defines how Central Economy counts and replenishes one game class.

category.description: Categories classify the item and can constrain which loot locations accept it. Names must be defined in cfglimitsdefinition.xml.

cost.description: Cost is the economy cost assigned to spawning this class and is used when the CE schedules eligible types for replenishment.

flags.description: Flags determine which existing instances count toward the economy target and whether this entry is treated as crafted or dynamic-event loot.

lifetime.description: Lifetime is how long, in seconds, an eligible spawned instance can remain before economy cleanup removes it.

min.description: Min is the lower count threshold for this class. When the counted amount falls below it, the economy prioritizes bringing the amount back up.

name.description: Name is the game configuration class name whose economy rules are set by this entry.

nominal.description: Nominal is the target number of counted instances the economy maintains for this class across the world.

quantmax.description: QuantityMax is the maximum fill percentage for items with a variable quantity, such as magazines, food, or liquid containers.

quantmin.description: QuantityMin is the minimum fill percentage for items with a variable quantity, such as magazines, food, or liquid containers.

restock.description: Restock is the delay, in seconds, used by the economy before it can replenish this class after its count falls below target.

tag.description: Tags provide additional location filters, commonly selecting placement within a building. Names must be defined in cfglimitsdefinition.xml.

usage.description: Usages identify the location contexts in which the item may spawn, such as military or town. Names must be defined in cfglimitsdefinition.xml.

value.description: Values classify the item's tier or special status and can constrain its spawn locations. Names must be defined in cfglimitsdefinition.xml.

TypeFlags.description: TypeFlags controls which locations contribute existing instances to the type's economy count and marks special spawn handling.

count_in_cargo.description: CountInCargo includes instances stored inside another item's cargo when the CE compares the current count with Nominal and Min.

count_in_hoarder.description: CountInHoarder includes instances kept in hoarder storage, such as tents, barrels, and buried stashes.

count_in_map.description: CountInMap includes instances placed in the world, including loot at ordinary spawn locations.

count_in_player.description: CountInPlayer includes instances in player inventories when calculating the economy count.

crafted.description: Crafted marks a type as crafted for CE handling; it does not define a crafting recipe.

deloot.description: Deloot marks a type for dynamic-event loot handling rather than ordinary building loot placement.

TypesFile.description: TypesFile is the Central Economy item catalog in `db/types.xml`.

type.description: Types are the item classes whose loot economy rules are defined here.

types.description: XMLName identifies the required `<types>` document root.
